notes.title: Florifer Tech Demo 0.8.0 Live Now!
notes.content:
​Greetings, Bearers!

A new update for Florifer's tech demo just dropped.
We fixed several bugs and issues and improved the game's UI.

notes.title: Florifer Tech Demo 0.7.0 is live now!
notes.content:
​Greetings, Bearers!

A brand new version of Florifer's Tech Demo just released!
With 0.7.0 come important bug fixes, as well as graphical tweaks and improvements, an all-new looking interface and minor balance adjustments to the flower you can grow.

Thank you and have fun!

NuraxInteractive
